title: Offline Lab index manifest
description: The root manifest of an index (proposed filename: index.json — index contract, open item 1), signed by the index key (index.json.p7s). Identity = the index KEY, never the URL (ADR-0033). The signature provides catalog integrity and anti-freeze for subscribers — NEVER trust; trust rides the build signatures inside the DDIs (ADR-0037). Every index is always signed, including a device's local collection.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the index. The consumer's local alias (used in `get <alias>/<name>`) is chosen at `index trust` and is NOT this field.

classes.description: Which artifact classes this index serves, with their RELATIVE paths (all internal references are relative so a verbatim copy works at any location).

apps.description: Relative path of the apps class (functional images devs ship).

bases.description: Relative path of the bases class.

keys.description: All certs this index distributes. Roles are POSITIONAL in this list (Q-B5: certs carry no markings). The build-cert entries are a cert-DISTRIBUTION convenience pinned at `index trust` — not a trust root (ADR-0037, delegation demoted).

key_id.description: SHA-256 of the DER-encoded certificate, lowercase hex.

role.description: index = this index's identity key; build = a builder cert this index distributes.

cert_path.description: Relative path to the PEM cert (conventionally keys/<fingerprint>.crt).

active.description: False during rotation wind-down (ADR-0007 gradual multi-cert).

key_rotation.description: Monotonic counter bumped on key-set changes (ADR-0007). Subscribers detect rotation via this.

version.description: Monotonic index version, bumped on every publish. Anti-rollback for SUBSCRIPTIONS only (imports consume no foreign catalog). Must move together with published_at — any disagreement means the consumer bails (session §20/§21).

published_at.description: Unixtime set at signing (signing IS publishing — the index is files). Cross-checked against version: equal version with different timestamp, newer version with older timestamp, or older version with newer timestamp are all refused. Doubles as the human staleness display.
